title: Kites in the Wind
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 5, 92-sound stage (e-e, i-e just added).

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling sitting on the grass, looking up at the sky.
A bright kite flying high up against a blue sky.

pages.text: Wind can lift a kite up.
pages.illustration: A gust of wind catching a kite and lifting it upward.

pages.text: A kite has a long tail.
pages.illustration: Close view of a kite with a long ribbon tail trailing behind it.

pages.text: The tail helps the kite sail well.
pages.illustration: The kite's long tail streaming out straight behind it as it flies steadily.

pages.text: A kite is wide, not thin.
pages.illustration: A wide kite shape shown clearly against the sky.

pages.text: A gust of wind can lift a kite fast.
pages.illustration: A sudden gust catching the kite and pulling it sharply upward.

pages.text: Without wind, a kite can not sail.
pages.illustration: A kite drooping and falling on a still, windless day.

pages.text: Five kites sail at the park.
pages.illustration: Five colourful kites flying together over the park.

pages.text: Ned likes to see kites sail fine.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling watching happily as the kites fly overhead.
